title: Wire worker document pipeline

context.summary: Register document worker processors for scan, extract, chunk, embed and index jobs, with durable chunk persistence.
context.background: TASK-18 makes API uploads create documents and enqueue scan jobs. TASK-19 adds the worker-side runtime chain that consumes those jobs and advances documents through the processing pipeline.

in: Add a document chunk persistence contract and Drizzle repository.
Register document.scan, document.extract, document.chunk, document.embed and document.index processors in the worker runtime.
Make clean scan jobs enqueue extraction jobs.
Extract text to object storage, persist chunks, and enqueue embedding/indexing when configured.
Keep vector index runtime optional until TASK-20.
Add a worker runtime builder and start entrypoint.
Update docs and validation scripts for the worker document pipeline.
out: Implement pgvector schema or semantic vector search.
Implement jobs HTTP API list/status/retry endpoints.
Implement automatic memory derivation or session summaries.
Replace Docker Compose placeholder worker service.

acceptance_criteria: @mindory/db exports a chunk repository that can replace, list and update embedding ids for document chunks.
Worker runtime builds DB, storage, queue, dispatcher and document processors from config.
document.extract stores extracted text and enqueues document.chunk.
document.chunk replaces persisted chunks and marks documents chunked or embed_pending.
document.embed and document.index processors are registered and no-op safely when embeddings/vector index are not configured.
Docs and validation scripts reflect that worker processors are wired but Docker Compose still uses placeholders.

manual_checks: Confirm pgvector search remains out of scope.
Confirm Docker Compose worker service remains a placeholder until TASK-26.
Confirm jobs HTTP routes remain out of scope.

risks: Worker runtime is compiled and structurally validated but not exercised against live PostgreSQL, Redis or ClamAV in this task.
Default embeddings are disabled, so indexing remains skipped until embeddings and vector runtime are configured in later tasks.
Chunk replacement is idempotent for retries but can replace chunk rows if a document is reprocessed.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch can be merged into master without unrelated changes.
